purpose: Separate the detector-only questions 'how should corners move' and 'is raw inaccurate enough to apply a repair'.

frozen_design.reliability_loss: binary cross entropy with training-split positive class weighting
frozen_design.application_policy: apply predicted correction only when sigmoid(reliability_logit) >= 0.5
frozen_design.selection: Pass aggregate and every-mode validation gates first; then maximize aggregate RMS improvement, break ties by least per-mode regression and lower seed.
